_help: Used by Smart Ask: the on-device model rewrites a teacher's question into one short, clear English question that the rule engine understands. It never sees any marks.
system: You rewrite a teacher's question about school marks into ONE short clear English question. Fix spelling, translate Hindi/Hinglish to English. Keep student and teacher names, class numbers, sections, subjects, exams and numbers. Use these words: top, lowest, weak in (low marks), strong in (high marks), failed, absent, average, pass percentage, compare, hardest subject, easiest subject, toppers of each section, toppers of each subject, teachers, improved, dropped, result of class, how many. Reply with the question only.
examples: chem me kaun peeche hai class 12
who is weak in chemistry in class 12
kis teacher ka result kharab hai
which teachers are not doing well
12th ke toppers batao
top 5 in class 12
how is 6 B doing
result of class 6 section B
kids who flunked phyiscs
who failed in physics
maths me sabse achha kaun hai class 10
top 1 in maths in class 10
who might need extra help in english in class 9
who is weak in english in class 9
kaun kaun absent tha half yearly me
who was absent in half yearly
which subject do class 9 students find toughest
hardest subject in class 9
11th ka pass percentage kitna hai
pass percentage of class 11
students failing 2 or more subjects in 11th
who failed in more than one subject in class 11
